svg.text: Ranked doubles · median match rank Diamond II div 4 · diamond band
2902 games · win rate 52% · compared with 103 diamond players with 30+ games
percentile vs diamond · bars fade with reliability
Percentiles use shrunk means (empirical Bayes); lower-is-better metrics are shown in the good direction. xG, threat and value added are conditioned on match rank.
Faded bars persist least from game to game for anyone (split-half reliability); "noise" marks metrics under 0.2, "style" metrics with no good direction.
